title: export_ledger_transaction drops PostTxApplyFeeChanges, so Soroban fee refunds (P23+) are missing from the row
severity_basis: TransformLedgerTransaction marshals only Envelope, Result, UnsafeMeta and FeeChanges, so the post-apply fee refund of every refunded Soroban transaction is missing from the row; tx_result.feeCharged is still correct, but anything that rebuilds balances from the row's ledger entry changes is off by the refund (the issue states the impact as internal only).

entries.expected: the exported row carries the post-apply fee refund changes
entries.observed: Not checked by the kit's runs: no run compares export_ledger_transaction's ledger entry changes with the ledger. By hand at 2b24ec89 on pubnet ledger 59501299, transaction 506c9f02…: the row's balance changes add up to -133207 where the fee charged is 59924; the two postTxApplyFeeProcessing changes appear nowhere in the row.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's Go test at stellar-etl 2b24ec89 (v2.8.34) and release-v20261117 03c64ea on pubnet ledger 59501299 (transaction 506c9f02…): balance delta from the LedgerCloseMeta -59924, from the exported row -133207.
evidence.expected_basis: Since Protocol 23 the Soroban resource fee refund is applied in TransactionResultMetaV1.postTxApplyFeeProcessing (LedgerTransaction.PostTxApplyFeeChanges), outside tx_meta; export_transactions already appends these changes.

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18 at 2b24ec89 with the issue's test on a local copy of pubnet ledger 59501299: row delta -133207, ledger delta -59924, 2 post-apply changes missing.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/stellar-etl/issues/511; this record restates the public issue.
